To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the lateral hypothalamic-perifornical (Hypothalamus-PF) region contains neurons responsible for producing cardiovascular (CV) changes associated with emotion or a defense reaction.

electrical stimulation of the lateral hypothalamo-perifornical area elicits a cardiovascular pattern of responses that is not elicited by stimulation of the paraventricual nucleus and that the cardiovascular pattern is eliminated or severely attenuates by destruction or inactivation of the lateral hypothalamic-perifornical area.
the lateral hypothalamo-perifornical region of the hypothalamus is the source of the neuronal cell bodies responsible to produce cardiovascular responses associated with emotion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the neural mechanisms underlying emotional behavior.
the neural mechanisms that control the autonomic nervous system (ANS) responses associated with emotional states and defense reactions.
the neuroanatomical basis of the emotional component of the defense reaction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CV responses associated with emotion and the defense reaction are produced by neurons located in the LH/Pf region and not in the PVN.
the LH/PF is the source of neurons that produce the CV pattern of autonomic responses associated directly with emotional states.
the LH/PF area is the source of the neuronal cell bodies responsible, at least in part, for the autonomic response pattern associated with emotion or a defense reaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LH/PF is the source of the neurons that control the CV responses associated with the defense reaction and that PVN neurons are not involved.
the PVN does not participate in the generation of CV responses elicited by stimulation or lesions in the LH/Pf region.
the LH/PF is the source of the neuronal cell bodies responsible in the brain for producing the autonomic responses that accompany the defense reaction or the emotional response.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the PVN is not involved in the production of the CV responses associated with emotion.
the LH/PF is a key region in the control of the autonomic nervous system and that it is not necessary for the PVN to be intact for the LH/PF to exert its influence on the autonomic nervous systems.
the LH/PF is an important brain region that is involved in the generation of cardiovascular responses associated with the emotion or defense reaction.
